public-api.note: Maintenance CLI arguments changed; optional image_type restored to LinkUpdate.

auth-privacy.note: Personal identifiers removed and default admin password eliminated.

prod-config.note: Public templates and deployment proxy defaults sanitized.

irreversible.note: Public GitHub disclosure cannot guarantee recall of downloaded copies.

external-effects.note: User requested publishing a public GitHub repository.

untrusted-input.note: No new externally supplied input handler or trust boundary.

bulk-data.note: No production data accessed; export does not include database or uploads.

slo-capacity.note: No SLO or runtime capacity change.

infra-exposure.note: Source repository publication only, no service or firewall deployment.
